title: Anthropic opened at $111.50. The price was still moving.
friendlyTitle: Anthropic's shares opened at $111.50. The price was still moving.
summary: TechCrunch reported that Anthropic shares began trading on Nasdaq on 19 November, and that in the early minutes they were at $111.50, 33 percent above the $83 IPO price set on Wednesday. That price was already above the $70 to $78 range the company had projected. TechCrunch says the offering will raise over $81 billion.
